== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[It Could Be Worse (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|It Could Be Worse]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_esb_2pg_japanese/it_could_be_worse_japanese_white_border/48897 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/50f6761e6ac645a1ae13a4cfe36b568a/IMG_20220607_0100.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 812, 1072)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b7ad808b6372d55718a016aa8e08454b7cf430118dd807b4ca757b0117e21b5e</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
